candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `initialized=true;` so seeding the market no longer initializes the contract.
Replace `initialized=true;` with `initialized=false;` so after seeding the market the contract remains uninitialized.
Replace the assignment so DrugDealer sets ceoAddress to the zero address instead of msg.sender.
Delete the statement that adds newly produced kilos to Kilos[msg.sender], so Kilos is never increased during collectDrugs.
Double the number of new kilos added per collect, so Kilos[msg.sender] grows twice as fast as in P.
Delete the lastCollect timestamp reset, so pending drugs are never zeroed at the end of collectDrugs, inflating all later collectDrugs calls and thus the Kilos added to any user.
